title: Mud-toberfest at Muddy York Brewing Co.
summary: Join us on Saturday, Oct. 4th in the taproom for Mud-toberfest! It’s a celebration of beer and german fare with @theirvstreetside food truck serving from 6–9pm Oktoberfest favourites like bratwurst, pretzel bites, Oktoberfest fries and schnitzel sandwiches. It’s going to be a feast!
